evilradio.name: EvilRadio
evilradio.description: Here you find all Widgets related to the Evil-Radio Addon

menu.title: Our Stations
menu.description: You want to hear a song, but no moderator is live? No problem!
menu.description2: Click on the station and request your song. Wait a moment, and it will be played.

picker.clickToPlay: Click or press Enter to play
picker.scrollInfo: Mouse wheel ↑↓: Change volume | Middle click: Play/Pause
picker.listNavHint: Mouse / ↑↓: select | Scroll over list: scroll

streamSelected.title: Stream selected
streamSelected.text: The stream has been started successfully.

showCover.name: Show Cover
showCover.description: Show the album cover in the widget.

showLastSong.name: Show Last Song
showLastSong.description: Show the last song in the widget. (Modern Widget only)

backgroundBlur.name: Background Blur
backgroundBlur.description: Blur the background of the widget. (Modern Widget only)

backgroundColor.name: Background Color
backgroundColor.description: Color and transparency of the widget background. Fully transparent keeps the background invisible.

borderColor.name: Border Color
borderColor.description: Color and transparency of the widget border. Fully transparent keeps the border invisible.

progressBarColor.name: Progress bar fill color
progressBarColor.description: Color of the inner progress bar fill.

stationColor.name: Station color
stationColor.description: Text color of the station line. Use the reset button to restore the default color.

songColor.name: Song color
songColor.description: Text color of the song title. Use the reset button to restore the default color.

artistColor.name: Artist color
artistColor.description: Text color of the artist. Use the reset button to restore the default color.

enabled.name: Enable Addon
enabled.description: Enable or disable the Evil-Radio Addon

radioMenuKeybind.name: Radio Menu Keybind
radioMenuKeybind.description: Key to open the radio menu

stationPicker.name: Station menu
stationPicker.description: Look of the station list and equalizer.

backgroundColor.name: List background
backgroundColor.description: Color and transparency of the list menu (including alpha).

borderColor.name: List border
borderColor.description: Border color of the list menu (including alpha).

rowBackgroundColor.name: Row background
rowBackgroundColor.description: Background color of station rows (including alpha).

backgroundBlur.name: List blur
backgroundBlur.description: Background blur of the list menu (0 = off).

showEqualizer.name: Show equalizer
showEqualizer.description: Equalizer and EQ button in the list menu. Off = removed completely.

songColor.name: Song color
songColor.description: Text color for the song title in the list.

artistColor.name: Artist color
artistColor.description: Text color for the artist in the list.

timeColor.name: Time color
timeColor.description: Text color for playtime in the list.

showSongChangeNotification.name: Song Change Notification
showSongChangeNotification.description: Get a notification when the song changes

showLiveChatNotification.name: Mod live chat message
showLiveChatNotification.description: Shows a chat message when a host goes live according to the schedule – even if the radio is not playing.

autoStopOnFocusLoss.name: Auto-Stop on Focus Loss
autoStopOnFocusLoss.description: Automatically stop the stream when the game window loses focus

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: The volume of the radio stream (0-100%)

autoStart.name: Auto-Start Settings
autoStart.description: Configure automatic start of the last stream

enabled.name: Enable Auto-Start
enabled.description: Enable automatic start of the last played stream

mode.name: Auto-Start Mode
mode.description: Choose when the stream should automatically start

delay.name: Auto-Start Delay
delay.description: Delay in seconds before automatically starting the stream (0-10 seconds)

usageStatistics.name: Usage-based Sorting
usageStatistics.description: Manage usage statistics and sorting of streams

enabled.name: Usage-based Sorting
enabled.description: Sort stations based on usage frequency

resetStatistics.name: Reset Statistics
resetStatistics.description: Resets the usage statistics of the streams

audioStreamDebug.name: Audio Stream Debug
audioStreamDebug.description: Writes detailed audio debug messages to logs/evilradio/audio-debug.log (dropouts, underruns, reconnects).

reloadStreams.name: Reload Streams (only if you have problems)
reloadStreams.description: Reloads the stream list from the server. Only use if you have problems.

schedule.liveHint: Switch to the Mashup station now.
